newsitem.title: INDIA: Delhi shares end higher, profit-taking cuts gains.
newsitem.headline: Delhi shares end higher, profit-taking cuts gains.

text.p: Late selling by speculators ahead of the end of a settlement period trimmed early gains as share prices closed higher on the Delhi Stock Exchange on Thursday, brokers said.
The bourse's benchmark index ended 2.12 points higher at 912.47 points. The index had spurted to 918.55 in early trade.
Friday is the last day of the current settlement period.
"Tomorrow's settlement forced traders to offload their positions," said Ashok Arya of brokers S.C. Gupta. company.
Arya said prices were expected to fall further. "The fall in stock prices was a technical correction which was anticipated by the marketmen and is expected to continue tomorrow," he said.
TISCO rose 10.45 rupees to 218.25 on sustained buying by foreign institutional investors.
Reliance Industries closed 2.25 rupees lower at 363.75.
Hero Honda surged 39.50 rupees to 570.00 as the share entered a no-delivery period for the next one month.
State Bank of India dropped 0.85 rupees to 347.40.
